name: Nova Aznable
source:
Nova Aznable is an elite bodyguard and servant to Serenity. His main task is to keep her brother-in-law at bay. Nova is resourceful and experienced, but on this trip, he seems distracted. 
[From [url=https://teamotomegamejam.itch.io/the-algernon-affair]itch.io[/url]]
